parent.P88_status: DEV_FAIL_STRONG_W256; complete local source available but not on repo

hypothesis: The native TTT learns incompatible action keys from outcome-bearing fact embeddings and outcome-free query embeddings; raw action/effect coordinates may survive a simpler consistent key map. Frozen keys-only ablations isolate key/query mismatch, context mixing and FIT-only linear action recoverability without changing original weights.

sources.source_generator: Same P86 platform-independent SHA256/dyadic causal map with NEW seeds. 48 executed and observed continuous actions/effects (rank4 map, hidden change after 24 in half worlds), then unseen query action effect withheld. Build 97 Q,F alternating tokens. No future effects written, no exact query duplicates; FIT/VAL source SHA must match across platforms. Do not generate OOD.

arms.raw_direct: P86 CAL-locked eta1 decay0.99 W16x16, normalized raw action keys and true observed effects.
arms.stem_shared: Use original frozen stem([action,0]) then original frozen ttt.query(ttt.norm) to encode both factual write keys and current query; true raw observed effects as values.
arms.context_shared: Use original frozen stem->SSM->causalAttention PRE-confirmation query representations and original ttt.query head for both factual keys and subsequent queries; true observed effects as values.
arms.context_mismatched: Use original frozen ttt.key on outcome-bearing confirmed fact embedding to write, and ttt.query on preceding action-only query embedding to read; true raw effects as values. Native key/query geometry, not a native value/readout replica.
arms.ridge_recovered_action: Fit only on FIT query embeddings a 272-coefficient L2 ridge alpha0.01 to raw normalized actions; on VAL derive keys for historical actions and final query, update same W256 with true effects. Extra supervised FIT parameters and compute, diagnostic not matched.

controls.frozen_random_original: Unmodified original HybridPilot width16 all blocks, 3 independent frozen model seeds; original 5297 weights unchanged.
controls.fast_memory: Exactly 16x16=256 float32 per world. eta1 decay0.99, read-before-write; 48 confirmed effect updates, no unconfirmed write, original SSM/attention state costs separately disclosed.
controls.metrics: Final MSE stable, changed, combined; late t32-48 prequential MSE; wall CPU timing and exact source/model/coefficient hashes.
controls.negative: Predeclared wrong-credit control within VAL by rotating 48 historical effects while preserving true final answer; direct W256 wrong-credit MSE>=1.5x clean and >=0.01.
controls.admission: FIT/VAL source/cold/causal audits PASS, fixed raw MSE <=.8 zero in stable and changed, 3 distinct model initial SHAs, all finite.
controls.future: No heldout/negative source family creation; no scientific first-use.

decisions.mismatch: In all 3 seeds, mismatched final MSE >=2x raw fixed and shared-context final MSE <=.85*mismatched; otherwise mismatch not established.
decisions.context: In all 3 seeds shared-context final MSE >=1.5x stem-shared; otherwise context effect not established.
decisions.recoverability: In all 3 seeds FIT-only ridge-recovered action final MSE <=1.20x fixed raw; if fail no evidence of linear action recovery.
decisions.status: DEV_MECHANISTIC_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY on admissible source and at least one all-seed signature. Else DEV_INCONCLUSIVE/NEGATIVE. Never SCIENTIFIC_PASS or evidence of full trained-model gains.
decisions.freeze: No post-result threshold changes, no training extensions, no OOD consumption.
